nvitk.segmentation.eicab.run_job¶

In-container entry point for eICAB (used by SGE singularity exec jobs).

Paths are under the outer pipeline container mounts (/nvitk/data/, /nvitk/output/, etc.). run_eicab() runs the inner eICAB singularity run with the same bind layout as legacy run_eicab_inference.sh (TOF bind, output, /tmp, vasculature on PATH).

Functions¶

main(→ int)

CLI entry point for a single eICAB job (parse args, run, return an exit code).
